interpretation.note: Legacy coverage rows are evidence and prioritization input, not a migration order. Covered or partially covered status means a useful sandbox baseline exists, not that legacy algorithms or task-local implementations should be promoted unchanged.

coverage.notes: S1 proves one external target is resolved to an explicit provider and invoked through an interpreter plan.
coverage.recommendation: Promote only the explicit provider binding and object-in/object-out invocation seed after review.

coverage.notes: S2 proves memory state-store read and write current behavior across executions.
coverage.recommendation: Use S2 as seed for a formal state-store provider contract.

coverage.notes: S2 covers current value read/write, but not subscription, async update propagation, packet path, or built-in property node variants.
coverage.recommendation: Create Round S6 retained-current-notification to cover push notification, subscriptions, packet path, and property node variants.

coverage.notes: S3 covers Promise-style await and reject diagnostic, but not old Result/Option wrappers, nested thenable composition, cancellation, or awaited sequence steps.
coverage.recommendation: Create Round S7 completion-result-model to reconcile Option/Result, awaited steps, cancellation, and async diagnostic policy.

coverage.notes: S1-S5 do not cover push stream propagation, listener registration, unsubscribe, demux/mux/merge/map-to, or path-level event packets.
coverage.recommendation: Create Round S8 event-stream to cover emit/subscribe, stream nodes, event packet paths, and listener teardown.

coverage.capability: runtime hooks and plugin event taps
coverage.notes: S1-S5 do not cover transform/override hooks or structured runtime event hooks.
coverage.recommendation: Defer until core interpreter behavior is promoted. Then decide which hooks become observation feature, execution policy, or plugin-only packaging.

coverage.capability: session/run id and nested runtime bookkeeping
coverage.notes: S1-S5 do not model LU/LUI run ids, outer/inner session stacks, or nested closure/subflow bookkeeping.
coverage.recommendation: Create Round S9 runtime-session after closure and event semantics are clearer.

coverage.notes: Legacy runtime exposes plugin objects for loading hooks and service/projector overrides. Current architecture says Plugin is packaging/loading strategy, not a core LogicIR ecosystem term.
coverage.recommendation: Do not migrate Plugin as a LogicIR core concept. Preserve needed behavior as provider capability, pass provider, execution policy, or local package-loading strategy.

coverage.capability: LU/LUI projection into executable runtime plan
coverage.notes: S1-S4 emit small task-local plans for one semantic slice each, but not a general graph scheduler, recursive LU projection, or multi-LUI topology.
coverage.recommendation: Create Round S10 multi-lui-plan for topological scheduling, recursive LU targets, and reusable interpreter-plan schema.

coverage.notes: S4 proves closure fulfillment conceptually, but its closure body is a task-local function, not a projected Closure core.
coverage.recommendation: Extend S4 with a formal closure-core fixture before promotion.

coverage.notes: S1/S4 cover explicit provider and upstream provider, but not defaultProvider, fallback closure, source-scoped provider, or dynamic/switchable provider behavior.
coverage.recommendation: Create Round S11 provider-resolution to cover default provider, source lineage, fallback closure, and dynamic binding policy.

coverage.notes: S1-S5 have no extension point for overriding manifestation/projection or transforming runtime data.
coverage.recommendation: Defer. These likely belong to execution tooling or observation/adapter features, not core.

coverage.notes: S1-S5 use single combinational/stateful slices and do not execute ordered sequential steps.
coverage.recommendation: Create Round S12 sequential-basic to cover ordered steps and sequence return.

coverage.notes: S3 covers async provider completion, but not sequence-level awaited step semantics.
coverage.recommendation: Add to Round S12 or S7 after basic sequential execution exists.

coverage.notes: No loop/back-edge control-flow lowering is covered by S1-S5.
coverage.recommendation: Create Round S13 control-flow to model guard, branch, go-back, and diagnostics for unsupported cycles.

coverage.notes: No early return or guarded return behavior is covered by S1-S5.
coverage.recommendation: Add to Round S13 control-flow with go-back-if.

coverage.notes: S1-S5 do not cover structural composition, component context, root composition, or child fills.
coverage.recommendation: Create Round S14 structural-composition after interpreter plan supports multi-LUI topology.

coverage.notes: Edit operations are useful for authoring tooling but not required for software interpreter MVP.
coverage.recommendation: Defer to a separate authoring/edit-model roadmap after core runtime promotion.

coverage.notes: Reconciliation belongs to authoring/editor implementation, not basic-software-interpreter runtime.
coverage.recommendation: Defer; extract only after edit model is intentionally designed.

coverage.capability: editor model lowering to runtime model
coverage.notes: Not covered by S1-S5, but the need for an explicit projection/lowering step is represented in the architecture. No implementation exists yet.
coverage.recommendation: Create a later authoring-to-logicir or editor-lowering task, not part of interpreter MVP.

coverage.notes: S1-S5 do not build a reusable node/LUI catalog or constant provider fixtures.
coverage.recommendation: Create Round C1 node-catalog-seed for constants and pass-through utilities.

coverage.notes: S1 has one ad hoc add provider, but not the old stdlib catalog.
coverage.recommendation: Create Round C2 stdlib-scalar-catalog after provider invocation is promoted.

coverage.notes: S1-S5 do not cover payload packing/unpacking, destructuring, or payload path compatibility.
coverage.recommendation: Create Round C3 payload-structure-catalog tied to payloadPath and type-system work.

coverage.notes: Requires event-stream runtime support, absent from S1-S5.
coverage.recommendation: Depend on Round S8 event-stream.

coverage.notes: S3 proves async provider completion, but not await/delay node catalog entries.
coverage.recommendation: After S7, add catalog fixtures for await and delay.

coverage.notes: S2 covers generic state store read/write, but not property.array/boolean/number/object/string catalog entries.
coverage.recommendation: After S6, add typed property node catalog fixtures.

coverage.notes: UI rendering nodes are valuable historical evidence but outside basic-software-interpreter MVP and may belong to a separate feature/profile.
coverage.recommendation: Defer to structural/UI projection roadmap; do not include in core.

coverage.notes: Domain nodes should not drive core or basic interpreter design.
coverage.recommendation: Defer until the provider/catalog packaging model is formalized.
